text:
Julie (AE): Heads up — Acme Bank POC is stuck on security/legal. They insist on no public endpoints; asking for VPC peering or Private. Need exec alignment.

Tom (SE): Notes from today's call:
- Required: SAML SSO, SCIM
- Required: VPC peering/private endpoint (no internet-facing)
- Required: SOC2 Type II + pen test summary
- SLA ask: 99.95% for production; POC needs data isolation only

Maria (Security): We can provide SOC2 docs and a redacted pentest report. VPC peering supported for Dedicated/Private, but we need their network contact (CIDR, firewall rules). For a POC we can spin an isolated dedicated tenant with no retention as a compromise.

Ash (Eng Lead): Tradeoffs: Private/on-prem takes 10-14 business days to fully provision and QA. Dedicated VPC peering + isolated tenant can be spun much faster — estimate 3 business days after we receive networking info. Hosted-limited POC (dedicated tenant, retention off) could be done in ~48-72 hours.

Julie (AE): They're leaning on on-prem for compliance. Sales needs timeline + pricing delta for Private vs Dedicated. They also asked about 12mo conversion pricing if SLA met.

Sarah (VP Sales): @Julie let's escalate. Clarify must-haves vs nice-to-haves so we can propose two tracks. What's the minimum ARR to justify Private?

Tom (SE): Customer must-haves: VPC/private endpoint, SAML, SOC2. Nice-to-have: full on-prem deployment (they prefer it but indicated VPC might be acceptable). From ops, VPC+dedi is quicker.

Dylan (Legal): Send their redline doc to me. Legal can fast-track ECA review for enterprise deals > $250k ARR. SLA negotiation: 99.9% vs 99.95% depends on multi-region config and paid commitment. Need to review indemnity caps in their redlines.

Julie (AE): Links: POC brief: https://docs.internal/redwood/pocs/acme-bank  Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/POC-312

deploy-bot: POC environment created [env-id: poc-acme-2024-04] (provisioning started) :gear:

Maria (Security): I'm sending their security checklist to fill out:
- Network contact + allowed CIDR
- SAML IdP metadata
- Data classification addendum (PII/financial)
- Penetration test scope for POC

Ash (Eng Lead): If legal OKs redlines we can prioritize a dedicated cluster. ETA for VPC peering: 3 business days after we get CIDR/firewall rules. Full Private (on-prem) still 2+ weeks. Ops needs a signed ECA for private installation.

Sarah (VP Sales): Proposed two-track offer for the customer:
1) Fast-track Dedicated POC (VPC peering) — 3 business days to demo; discounted POC rate; conversion option to 12mo reserved capacity.
2) Full Private deployment — enterprise contract only; +35% implementation fee; 2-3 weeks lead time.

Julie (AE): Customer asked about discount ranges. How deep can we go for a 12mo commit post-POC?

Tom (SE): We have flexibility up to ~30% off list for committed 12mo depending on GPU and throughput requirements; needs sales ops input.

Sarah (VP Sales): I can approve up to 25% discount. >25% requires CRO approval. For deals > $500k ARR we can go to 35% and consider covering implementation fees.

Dylan (Legal): Action: I will review their tracked redlines today. Send to dl@redwood.com.

Julie (AE): I have a follow-up with their CTO at 16:00 PT. I'll request network contact and their redlined PDF.

Maria (Security): Customer requested clause to delete raw logs immediately after POC sessions. We can support configurable retention for the POC environment but need ops confirmation.

Ash (Eng Lead): We can set no-token-log retention for POC envs. Ops needs ~24 hours to apply retention config.

Julie (AE): Action list:
- Julie: get network contact + tracked redlines in the 16:00 PT call (today)
- Dylan: legal to review and return ECA comments (EOD)
- Maria: prepare SOC2 + pen test artifacts and retention statement (today)
- Ash/Tom: cost estimate + ETA for dedicated POC and retention config (today)
- Sarah: approves up to 25% discount; CRO path for deeper discounts

Tom (SE): I'll put together a short technical one-pager for the call and a simple diagram for VPC peering.

Sarah (VP Sales): Exec note: if this slips because of on-prem requirement, escalate to me immediately. We need to keep momentum.

Julie (AE): Will update after the call. Thanks all :pray:
